ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Nobel Prize in Economics winner Arthur Lewis proposed the “dual economy” development model. Economic development is divided into two stages: one is the stage of unlimited labor supply, and the other is the stage of labor shortage; the intersection point connecting the two stages is called the “Lewis turning point.” After the New Spring, the phenomenon of “difficulty recruiting workers” also appeared in coastal areas and even in major labor-exporting provinces such as Jiangxi and Sichuan, and the “Lewis turning point” of China’s economy may have arrived early. <image1> What is the special background for the possible early arrival of China’s “Lewis turning point”?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: Due to the implementation of family planning, the proportion of the working-age population has declined

raw_record.original_question:
诺贝尔经济学奖获得者阿瑟·刘易斯提出了“二元经济”发展模式。将经济发展分为两个阶段：一是劳动力无限供给阶段，二是劳动力短缺阶段，联接两个阶段的交点称为“刘易斯拐点”。新春过后，在沿海甚至江西、四川等劳务输出大省也出现“招工难”现象，中国经济的“刘易斯拐点”可能提前到来了。

<image1>

中国“刘易斯拐点”可能提前到来的特殊背景是什么？
raw_record.answer: Due to the implementation of family planning, the proportion of the working-age population has declined
